body:
Documentation half of the quartermaster layer built by T151 (docs/specs/operating-stack.md §4-§5). T151's ticket contract is frozen — it is a base ticket on main, and rails-guard-ci permits no change to a merged ticket's contract — so the documentation this work requires is authorized here instead of by widening T151.

What to write:

1. `docs/integrations/quartermaster-registry.md` — the schema reference the spec commissions in §4b ("The repo carries only docs/integrations/quartermaster-registry.md — schema reference and an annotated example. Dispatch never reads it."). Must cover: where the file may live and the operator-local path rule (absolute, outside the repo under review; a relative or in-repo path DISABLES loading with a notice rather than reading it); the engagement rule (the registry governs dispatch when ADLC_QUARTERMASTER_REGISTRY is set or the default home/XDG file exists, otherwise fleet keeps its --adapter/fleet.model behavior); an annotated example of every field; a field reference for channel entries and reviewer-group members; the full rule 1-7 table with what each rule rejects; what a normalized provider string is and which implementation is authoritative; the adapter-owned alias contract with each adapter's declared aliases and model flag; and how to check a registry with `adlc fleet run --dry-run`.

2. `apps/docs/content/docs/toolkit/quartermaster.mdx` — the toolkit page for the new package, in the same shape as the other pages (frontmatter title/description, phase line, `<PhaseDiagram>`, a "What it defends against" section, usage, and a "Go deeper" link). Explain the trust boundary the layer exists for: a candidate tree that can name its own reviewer or repoint `frontier` at something cheap can lower the bar it is about to be judged against.

3. Register the package so the docs app stays consistent: add `quartermaster` to the "Execution supervision & rails" group in `apps/docs/lib/toolkit-packages.mjs` and to `apps/docs/content/docs/toolkit/meta.json`.

Acceptance criteria:
- `node --test apps/docs/test/*.test.mjs` passes. This is the binding check: `toolkit-packages.test.mjs` asserts the listed packages and the `packages/` directories match exactly (bijective) and that every listed package has a toolkit page, so a new package under `packages/` fails this suite until both the registration and the page exist. `toolkit-usage-dispatcher.test.mjs` additionally asserts every shell command in a toolkit page dispatches through `adlc <tool>` rather than a bare tool binary — so the dry-run example must read `adlc fleet run --dry-run`, never `fleet run --dry-run`.
- Every rule the registry reference documents matches what `packages/quartermaster/lib/registry.mjs` actually enforces; no rule is described as enforced when it is only asserted by the operator. Where a rule cannot be checked mechanically (alias resolutions that a harness resolves to a floating "latest"), the reference must say so plainly rather than imply full verification.
- No file outside `apps/docs/**` and `docs/integrations/**` is touched by this ticket.

Out of scope: the package implementation itself and any fleet wiring (T151); `adlc quartermaster check` and its docs (spec §9 item 5).
title: Document the quartermaster layer: registry schema reference + toolkit page
